ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with less than 5% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized to scars and parasitic clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear streaks are mapped to the left lobe; small, high-intensity circular pixel clusters are mapped to the lateral tips and scattered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 110-120 degrees and a depth equivalent to roughly 10% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (2-8 pixel depth) along the continuous linear boundary, particularly pronounced on the inner half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and tapering to a convex profile at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary sparse distribution of white punctate marks on the dorsal-facing surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, parallel, high-contrast diagonal linear marks (rake marks) on the left lobe; isolated single linear scratches on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed rake mark scars on the left lobe and barnacle encrustations at the lateral extremities.
